questions.stem: A 2-year-old child presents to the clinic with a persistent cough lasting for 2 weeks. The cough consists of rapid, consecutive coughs followed by an inspiratory gasp and post-tussive vomiting. The child's 5-year-old sibling, who attends preschool, developed similar symptoms 10 days ago.Based on the clinical presentation and exposure history described, what is the likelihood that the child's sibling will develop similar symptoms within the next few weeks?
